summary: This note describes the music video for the song "Wake Me Up When September Ends." It follows a young couple played by Jamie Bell and Evan Rachel Wood, where the boyfriend enlists in the United States Marine Corps despite promising never to leave, causing an argument and heartbreak. The video intercuts his ambush in Iraq with the girlfriend mourning in a quiet field, ending on the pain of losing loved ones to war.
one_line: Plot summary of the music video for "Wake Me Up When September Ends," in which a boyfriend's Marine enlistment and Iraq deployment bring heartbreak to his girlfriend.
key_facts: The music video for "Wake Me Up When September Ends" focuses on a couple in love played by Jamie Bell and Evan Rachel Wood.
The boyfriend promises never to leave his girlfriend, but the couple later argues when he enlists in the United States Marine Corps.
The boyfriend interprets his enlistment as a way to show he loves her so much that he would put his life on the line to keep her safe.
The girlfriend is heartbroken because the boyfriend broke his vow to never leave her.
The video shows the boyfriend in battle in Iraq being ambushed by insurgents.
The Iraq ambush scenes are intercut with scenes of the girlfriend tearfully mourning in a quiet field.
The video ends on this juxtaposition, emphasizing the pain and heartache of losing loved ones due to war.
